facts.fact: Sénégal Numérique SA, the state company, presents itself as manager of the government technology infrastructure and coordinator of the ministries' IT departments; 176 structures host data at SENUM and 131 use its messaging service (21,120 accounts); the document is dated 2025 with no day given.

Sénégal Numérique SA, a state company, states it runs state data centres (Orana, Technopole, Diamniadio) and the government messaging service, and that 32 structures use its SENGEC SENCOLLAB tool and 29 its E-conf tool; dated 2025, no day given.
